title: Premabhishekam
desc: Rajesh falls in love with and proposes to Devi. However, a few days before their marriage, he learns that he has cancer and decides to make Devi hate him, so that she will marry another man.

title: Sooryavamsi
desc: The head of India's Anti-Terrorism Squad, Sooryavanshi, fights against all odds to take down a deadly terrorist group tied to his past.

title: Bharathchandran I.P.S.
desc: Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.

title: Dheeran Adhyayam Onnu
desc: A police officer is assigned the task of solving the mystery behind a series of murders. Upon thoroughly investigating, he discovers a common thread that binds all the murders together.

title: Loham
desc: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Yaanai
desc: Ravi, the youngest son of an influential family accused of causing a man's death, takes charge of defending them. However, amidst the turmoil, he unexpectedly falls for a woman.
